title: The Trail of the Coral Triangle
author: Sebastian Ravensworth
blurb: Bram Montrose, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
